record.question: Who has been selected as the new Director of CBI?
record.explanation: Answer C: Rishi Kumar Shukla. The Appointments Committee approved Rishi Kumar Shukla as CBI Director on 2 February 2019 for a two-year tenure from assumption of charge. The official appointment announcement names him, making the third printed choice correct. Historical/source note: Historical appointment in 2019, not the present Director of CBI. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1562429&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
